release.release_notes:
GaiaOS 0.4.8-beta.9 — Gaia UI and reversible graphics

- Settings → Video → Graphics rendering offers Automatic, GPU accelerated and Software OpenGL. Changes restart Gaia with a 20-second Keep changes/Revert countdown. An independent supervisor restores the previous choice on timeout, failed startup or a renderer crash. GPU trials reject software-only OpenGL contexts.
- Error, information, display and decision windows use Gaia's icon/title, centered message, divided footer and gradient focus border in Light and Dark.
- UI sound volume defaults to 100% for fresh profiles. Saved volume and mute preferences are preserved.
- Long dropdowns reveal their selected option and show progressive top/bottom edge blur when more options can be scrolled into view. The blur uses a single shader pass for software-renderer responsiveness.
- Controller prompts remain visible across Home, navigation, Settings, Files, the installer and modal windows, using the supplied Light/Dark A/B/X/Y SVGs. Popup prompts appear in a rounded panel above the dimming overlay.
- Gaia's renderer override is isolated from games and advanced emulator frontends.

Launcher/application update for compatible installations. No ISO or full-system image is included. The renderer setting does not install drivers or change the compositor. Existing Beta 4 installed systems retain their documented one-time recovery/reinstall requirement.

Fresh local Debian 13 amd64 build. Python recovery/regression checks, Qt QML syntax, ShellCheck, seven native CTest suites, real native renderer restart checks, controller/dropdown/modal regressions and Light/Dark screenshot review passed. 133 Python cases (132 passed, one optional RAUC integration skip), 27 QML files and seven CTest suites were checked. Controlled keyboard checks used Xvfb server auto-repeat disabled because Gaia owns repeat scheduling. Tests use Xvfb/Mesa, dummy audio and synthetic input; physical GPU/controller/audio, gameplay and installed-device acceptance remain pending Chris. Beta only; Stable unchanged.
